# Pinned spreadsheet parser

SheetJS Community Edition 0.20.3, Apache-2.0. Generated from the exact `xlsx.mjs` in the pinned project dependency with esbuild 0.25.12, `--minify --format=esm`. The application uses the same version through its normal package dependency. Vendoring is required because the managed function bundler rejects imports from cdn.sheetjs.com. No runtime network import is used.
